method: scripts/corpus_smoke.py: for each corpus project at HEAD, `cargo check|clippy|test --tests --no-run --workspace --offline` and the same Mitts command from an empty cache; a project agrees when both tools succeed or both fail and, for the test build, when both produce the same number of test executables.
